evidenceType: valid baseline versus visual-preserving frozen-groundcover A/B plus residence capture

performanceCritic.finding: The valid frozen-groundcover trace is statistically no better than baseline, so route-time groundcover streaming is no longer attributable.
performanceCritic.largestGap: The aggregate evidence cannot correlate the common tail with route startup, forest matrix/upload work, or later GPU buffer/render cost.
performanceCritic.requiredNext: Record bounded slow-frame incidents with route-cycle and work deltas, then compare cold collection with an identical measured route after one unmeasured full-route warmup and strategic pending-zero drain.

findings: The residence occupies about 32 percent of frame width versus about 67 percent in the close reference.
Facade and gable values remain in roughly the 25–50/255 band, merging logs, openings, eaves, porch, and shingles.
The frontal camera hides roof planes and a clipped foreground fence weakens the lived-in yard read.
residenceCritic.largestGap: Insufficient value separation makes the construction and wooden-roof hierarchy unreadable.
residenceCritic.requiredNext: Use a clean reference-scale three-quarter view and retune existing material values and ambient fill without adding dynamic lights or expensive geometry.
